extracted.name: Mint and Fruit Smoothie
extracted.description: This quick, frosty blender recipe has a thick texture, beautiful colors, and a fruity, mojito-like taste.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup unsweetened applesauce, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place frozen grapes, applesauce, and lime juice into a blender. Puree until smooth. Add frozen strawberries, cubed pineapple, and mint leaves. Pulse a few times until the strawberries and pineapple are in small bits.
